title: Follow iterative work alongside normal tasks
after: flowchart LR; A[Existing task] --> B[Plan and implement] --> C[Review and verify]; B --> D[Optional iterative goal]; D --> E[Experiments and reported findings]; E --> F[Inspect progress and results]
